svg.title: Andhra Pradesh · Segregation among collected households
svg.desc: 12 Aug 2026. Each coloured district shows the median reporting urban local body's share of collected households segregating waste. Lightest: at least 75%. Mid-green: 50% to below 75%. Deep teal: below 50%. Diagonal hatching: no matched reading. 24 of 26 reference districts are coloured. District geography: 2022.
